bit_field_value.description: Trigger completion interrupts are enabled for trigger source 0 only.

bit_field_value.name: CFG_TPRICTRL_ABORT_CURRENT_ON_PRIORITY
bit_field_value.description: Current conversion is aborted and the new command specified by the trigger is started.

bit_field_value.name: CFG_TPRICTRL_FINISH_CURRENT_ON_PRIORITY
bit_field_value.description: Current command is stopped after completing the current conversion. If averaging is enabled, the averaging loop is completed. CMDHn[LOOP] is ignored and the higher-priority trigger is serviced.

bit_field_value.name: CFG_TPRICTRL_FINISH_SEQUENCE_ON_PRIORITY
bit_field_value.description: Current command is completed (averaging, looping, compare) before servicing the higher-priority trigger.

bit_field_value.name: CFG_TCMDRES_ENABLED
bit_field_value.description: Trigger sequence resumed from the command that was executed prior to the exception.

bit_field_value.name: CFG_PWREN_NOT_PRE_ENABLED
bit_field_value.description: ADC analog circuits are only enabled while conversions are active. Analog startup delays affect performance.

bit_field_value.name: CFG_PWREN_PRE_ENABLED
bit_field_value.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays, at the cost of higher DC current consumption. A single power-up delay (CFG[PUDLY]) is executed immediately once PWREN is set. No detected triggers begin ADC operation until the power-up delay time has passed. After this initial delay expires, the analog circuits remain pre-enabled, and no additional delays are executed.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TEXC_NUM_NO_EXCEPTIONS
bit_field_value.description: No triggers have been interrupted by a high-priority exception.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TEXC_NUM_BIT0_MEANS_TRIGGER_0_INTERRUPTED
bit_field_value.description: Trigger 0 has been interrupted by a high-priority exception.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TEXC_NUM_BIT1_MEANS_TRIGGER_1_INTERRUPTED
bit_field_value.description: Trigger 1 has been interrupted by a high-priority exception.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TEXC_NUM_SET_BITS_INDICATE_TRIGGER_x_INTERRUPTED
bit_field_value.description: Associated trigger sequence has interrupted by a high-priority exception.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TEXC_NUM_ALL_BITS_SET_INDICATE_ALL_TRIGGERS_INTERRUPTED
bit_field_value.description: Every trigger sequence has been interrupted by a high-priority exception.

bit_field_value.description: No triggers have been completed. Trigger completion interrupts are disabled.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TCOMP_FLAG_BIT0_MEANS_TRIGGER_0_COMPLETED
bit_field_value.description: Trigger 0 has been completed and trigger 0 has enabled completion interrupts.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TCOMP_FLAG_BIT1_MEANS_TRIGGER_1_COMPLETED
bit_field_value.description: Trigger 1 has been completed and trigger 1 has enabled completion interrupts.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TCOMP_FLAG_SET_BITS_INDICATE_TRIGGER_x_COMPLETED
bit_field_value.description: Associated trigger sequence has completed and has enabled completion interrupts.

bit_field_value.name: TSTAT_TCOMP_FLAG_ALL_BITS_SET_INDICATE_ALL_TRIGGERS_COMPLETED
bit_field_value.description: Every trigger sequence has been completed and every trigger has enabled completion interrupts.
